title: Distributing the Segment Routing over IPv6 (SRv6) Locator Using DHCPv6
abstract: In an SRv6 network, each SRv6 Segment Endpoint Node must be assigned an SRv6 Locator, and segment identifiers (SIDs) are generated within the address space of this SRv6 Locator. This document describes a method for assigning SRv6 Locators to SRv6 Segment Endpoint Nodes through the Dynamic Host Configuration Protocol for IPv6 (DHCPv6).
